english-writing-coach 1.0.0 changelog

- Initial release of the interactive English writing coach skill.
- Supports all major writing types, including professional emails, academic essays, reports, creative writing, and IELTS/TOEFL writing.
- Uses a process-genre approach: teaches genre conventions first, models examples, guides planning and drafting, and provides structured feedback on content, coherence, vocabulary, and grammar.
- Adapts to learner level (A2–C2) and writing goals; gives clear, actionable feedback with each session.
- Includes a daily writing drill feature with practical short tasks and targeted vocabulary support.
- Designed to trigger help for any English writing improvement request, from formal exam preparation to everyday communication.
